title: Questions for the new website
intro: Thank you for all the answers so far! There are only a few questions left; they're under "Still to answer". Anyone can answer any question, and each answer saves as soon as you press Save.

questions.text: Do we own reddees.com? Who registered it, and where (GoDaddy, BigRock, etc.)? Do we have the login? Is anything live on it right now?
Whose number is 9860312218? What should the website call it?
questions.hint: For example: Sales, Service, Office, or a person's name.

questions.text: Is the landline 0712-6630625 still in use?
Which email should website enquiries go to?
IndiaMART lists K. Narender Reddy as proprietor. Should the About page name him as the founder?
Should the GST number (27AAKPR8599K1ZJ) be shown in the website footer?
questions.hint: Optional. It is not legally required on a website.

questions.text: After a sale, what do we provide: installation, operator training, repairs, spare parts?
Do we also offer AMC for machines that customers bought from someone else?
questions.hint: Earlier answer: "Xerox, Canon, Konica Minolta, Fujifilm and Riso"

questions.text: For corporate customers, what do we offer?
Do we sell consumables: toner, ink, RISO masters, paper, binding glue, lamination film?
Which refurbished or used machines do we sell?
questions.hint: Just the brands or machine types is enough, for example "Xerox and Canon copiers".

questions.text: What warranty comes with a refurbished machine?
The brochure shows the Lexmark CX951 inside the Xerox section. Do we sell Lexmark printers ourselves, or only that one model through Xerox?
What brand name is printed on the finishing machines (binder, cutters, laminator, creaser)? Is it okay to show that brand on the website, or should we keep them unbranded?
questions.hint: Earlier answer: "we are authorised partner for an importer"

questions.text: For Canon, Konica Minolta, Kyocera, Fujifilm, HP, Epson, Zebra and Evolis: are we an authorised dealer for any of them, or do we sell them as a general dealer?
Do we still sell these: Xerox Versant 280, Versant 4100, Xerox Iridesse, Fujifilm Apeos copiers, MAX label cutters, HP and Epson plotters? Is there anything new we sell that is not in the brochure?
questions.hint: Earlier answer: "now we are not dealing in KIP, projectors, interactive boards, currency counting"

questions.text: Which Fujifilm (Apeos) copiers and printers do we sell? Type the model names, or upload the Fujifilm brochure or price list here.
questions.hint: Photos of the brochure pages are fine too.

questions.text: Should the website show prices, or "price on request" for everything?
Should the website follow the brochure's colours (teal, plus the logo's colour ring), or are we open to a fresh look?
Please upload the original logo file here (AI, CDR, PDF or a high-resolution PNG). If it's on someone's computer, a photo won't work; we need the actual file.
Which languages should the website be in?

sections.title: Photos
sections.intro: Thank you for the photos! A few more would help: a phone camera is fine (daylight, landscape, area tidied first). Upload them here; they go straight to Natesh's Google Drive.

questions.text: Storefront: once the new board is up, a photo of the outside of the office with the board clearly visible.
questions.hint: Earlier answer: "boards under renovation, will send after one week"

questions.text: Office: wide shots of the inside, plus any machines kept there.
A portrait of Dad for the About page.
Team: service engineers and staff, as a group and at work.
A recent photo of the whole current team together, ideally at the office. This will go on the About page.
questions.hint: The two team photos uploaded so far include one from an event; a fresh group photo would be best.

questions.text: Machines running: prints coming out, a book being bound, a cut or a lamination in progress.
Installations at customer sites: schools, print shops or offices.
questions.hint: Ask the customer first. No faces or documents without permission.

questions.text: Service work: an engineer repairing a machine, the spares stock.
Certificates: authorised partner certificates from Xerox and RISO, and any dealer awards.
Events: trade fairs, product launches or customer meets, if any.

sections.title: Videos
sections.intro: Short clips of 10 to 60 seconds work best: hold the phone sideways and steady. Videos go straight to Natesh's Google Drive. Big videos can take a few minutes, so use Wi-Fi if you can and keep this page open until it says uploaded.

questions.text: Machines at work: prints coming out of a Xerox or RISO, a book being bound, cutting, laminating or creasing.
questions.hint: One short clip per machine is perfect. These can go on the product pages.

questions.text: Events: trade fairs, product launches, customer meets or any celebration.
Installations and service: a machine being set up at a customer's site, or an engineer at work.
questions.hint: Ask the customer first. Avoid showing faces or documents without permission.

questions.text: Anything else: a walk through the office, a customer saying a few words about us, or an existing promotional video.
questions.hint: If a video is already on YouTube or Google Drive, you can paste the link in the note instead.
